title: Start from an image you control

body.text: Upload a still image (your own photo, or one made in Midjourney) and have Runway animate it. This
than text-to-video, because you start from an image you've already chosen. Great for clips from brand/product images.

example: Upload a product image, then prompt: the camera slowly orbits the product, soft blurred background

title: Say only what should move

body.text: In image-to-video, have the prompt specify
, like 'hair and fabric flowing in the wind, while the background stays still.' Being clear prevents artifacts and gives a smoother result.

example: Make the steam from a coffee cup rise slowly, while the cup and table stay still

question: What's the benefit of image-to-video over text-to-video?

options.text: More precise control of composition, since you start from a chosen image
You don't write a prompt at all

question: In image-to-video, what should the prompt specify?

options.text: What should move and what should stay still
The number of viewers you want

question: What still images can you use?

options.text: Your own photos, or images made in Midjourney

question: What does clearly stating what stays still help with?

options.text: Preventing artifacts and getting a smoother result
